def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'], tuple(sorted(n['boundary']))))
    return d
before = snap(current_frame)
res = action(['RIGHT'])
after = snap(current_frame)
print('result:', {k:v for k,v in res.items() if k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
for c in set(list(before)+list(after)):
    b=before.get(c,[]); a=after.get(c,[])
    if b!=a:
        print('CHANGED',c)
        for x in b:
            if x not in a: print('  -',x)
        for x in a:
            if x not in b: print('  +',x)
print('step', current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
